Definition: Chanani, the name of six Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hanani = "gracious"; 1) one of the sons of Heman, a chief musician of David, and head of the 18th course of the service; 2) a seer who rebuked Asa, king of Judah, and was imprisoned; 2a) maybe, father of Jehu the seer who testified against Baasha; 3) one of the priests who in the time of Ezra took a foreign wife; 4) brother of Nehemiah whom Nehemiah appointed governor of Jerusalem; 5) another priest who was the chief musician under Nehemiah
